delivery.replay: Request one bounded point-in-time replay; never replace a missing archive with fixture data.

requests.purpose: Credential-safe activation context; not part of the polling render path.

unavailable: A missing GameFrame renders unavailable or stale, never fixture data while connected.
A replay without retained observations is unavailable; the starter never fabricates a timeline.
Polling stops at a final phase and reports the last measured request count.
Credentials stay in the copied server bridge and never enter browser source or request URLs.

instructions: Render auraRestScoreboardFixture first; fixture mode never requires a key.
Create one memoized createAuraLiveScoreboardClient() in a client component and pass it with an Aura gameId to useAuraRestScoreboard().
Use mode='poll' for RapidAPI request-metered REST and mode='replay' with an optional epoch millisecond at value for retained history.
The browser calls only the copied same-origin route. Keep AURA_API_KEY or RapidAPI credentials in server-only environment variables.
The starter intentionally polls REST; direct Aura resumable SSE remains a separate live-scoreboard adapter.
Connecting, polling, stale, final, replay, unavailable, and error remain explicit states.

customization.howTo: To pull more or fewer fields, edit the fields= list in this component’s client and the matching *-types.ts. Allowlists are published per object in GET /api/catalog (fieldCatalog); unknown or duplicate fields return 400.
